headline: Spain and France keep the gravy flowing
text: A tidy little quarter-final day for Grandad and Carolina: Spain (Grandad) and France (Carolina) both won, while Belgium (Vicki) and Morocco (Sara) had their rations pinched. Switzerland (Jack) and Colombia (Chris) could not be separated, so Jack at least avoided a proper shoeing. Overall, Max is still top of the pile on 29 points, with Grandad now best of the rest on 26. At the other end, Sofia remains bottom on 10, with Christopher not exactly flying either on 11. A couple of favourites moved on, a couple folded, and the sweepstake table keeps wobbling nicely.
